label: N-01 通知接收 · N-02 投递与重试
info:
N-01 通知接收：POST /api/notify 校验入参、按级别分流、组装卡片。
N-02 投递与重试：HTTP 投递、1/5/15 秒重试、写 notify_log。

边界：不做阈值求值、去抖、告警状态判定（那些在接入服务）。
无状态：不配置 flow context 持久化，流程不承载跨消息状态。

改完必须在编辑器里「导出」并提交 flows.json：界面里改了不导出，重装就丢。
运行时不承载跨消息状态，重启即清空。

name: 校验入参
查重 + 卡片元数据
query:
-- 一次查询回答三件事：这条通知是否已推送过、卡片要的配置域字段、可选的告警标识。
--
-- 幂等只看 notifyId + status='SENT'。同一条活动告警重复命中时判定段不会再投递
-- （活动集合挡住），所以这里不需要按 alarm_id 再判一次；判定段恢复后重新拉响
-- 会写一条新告警、新 occurTime，也就有新 notifyId，属于真正的新一次推送。
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notify_log WHERE notify_id = $1 AND status = 'SENT') AS duplicate,
       t.workshop, p.point_name, p.unit, p.bus_id, p.slave_addr, d.device_name,
       a.alarm_id
  FROM point p
  JOIN terminal t ON t.terminal_id = p.terminal_id
  JOIN device d ON d.terminal_id = p.terminal_id
               AND d.bus_id = p.bus_id AND d.slave_addr = p.slave_addr
  LEFT JOIN alarm a ON a.terminal_id = p.terminal_id
                   AND a.point_id = p.point_id
                   AND a.alarm_type = $4
                   AND a.occur_time = to_timestamp($5 / 1000.0)
 WHERE p.terminal_id = $2 AND p.point_id = $3
 ORDER BY a.alarm_id DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 1

name: 判定继续或终止
组装卡片
受理-跳过（level 1）
受理-投递（level 2~4）

写投递日志
query:
INSERT INTO notify_log
  (notify_id, alarm_id, channel, status, retry_count, http_code, fail_reason, sent_time)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, now())
ON CONFLICT (notify_id) DO UPDATE SET
  alarm_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.alarm_id, notify_log.alarm_id),
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  retry_count = EXCLUDED.retry_count,
  http_code = EXCLUDED.http_code,
  fail_reason = EXCLUDED.fail_reason,
  sent_time = EXCLUDED.sent_time

label: N-03 告警确认
info:
确认只写 alarm_ack（ackedBy / ackedTime），不改 alarm.status。
状态机是 ACTIVE → RECOVERED → ACKED：「确认」是独立的操作事件，
不是「恢复」的替代。把 status 改成 ACKED 会让判定的 Clear（只更新
status='ACTIVE' 的行）再也落不了真实恢复时间。

确认入口只此一处，adapter 不提供确认接口（BR-37）。

name: 校验入参
写确认 + 回读状态
query:
-- 一条语句完成两件事：写确认记录、回读每条告警确认后的状态。
--
-- 确认不改 alarm.status：状态机里 ACTIVE → RECOVERED → ACKED 是「先恢复后确认」，
-- 现场常常在告警还 ACTIVE 时就确认了。此时若把 status 改成 ACKED，
-- 判定的 Clear 只更新 status='ACTIVE' 的行，这条告警的真实恢复事件就永远落不了库。
WITH acked AS (
    INSERT INTO alarm_ack (alarm_id, acked_by, note)
    SELECT a.alarm_id, $2, $3
      FROM alarm a
     WHERE a.alarm_id = ANY($1::bigint[])
       AND a.status IN ('ACTIVE','RECOVERED')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alarm_ack x WHERE x.alarm_id = a.alarm_id)
    RETURNING alarm_id, acked_by, acked_time
)
SELECT a.alarm_id,
       a.status,
       a.alarm_type,
       a.point_id,
       (k.alarm_id IS NOT NULL) AS acknowledged,
       COALESCE(k.acked_by, prev.acked_by)     AS acked_by,
       COALESCE(k.acked_time, prev.acked_time) AS acked_time
  FROM alarm a
  LEFT JOIN acked k ON k.alarm_id = a.alarm_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT x.acked_by, x.acked_time
          FROM alarm_ack x
         WHERE x.alarm_id = a.alarm_id
         ORDER BY x.acked_time DESC
         LIMIT 1
  ) prev ON TRUE
 WHERE a.alarm_id = ANY($1::bigint[])
 ORDER BY a.alarm_id

label: N-04 写视图
info:
写视图的三个只读查询：活动告警清单、健康查看。
场景切换与跳转读视图由 Dashboard 的按钮直接打 HTTP，不在此处落业务流程。

本页签只读。所有写操作集中在 N-03。

name: 取终端过滤
活动告警清单
query:
-- 活动告警清单。确认只写 alarm_ack、不改 status，所以「是否已确认」要从
-- alarm_ack 的最新一条读，不能看 status。
-- 车间与测点名走 v_point_dict：point 表本身没有 workshop，终端才挂车间。
SELECT a.alarm_id,
       a.terminal_id,
       a.point_id,
       d.point_name,
       d.workshop,
       a.alarm_type,
       a.level,
       a.status,
       a.trigger_value,
       d.unit,
       a.threshold_value,
       a.occur_time,
       a.last_time,
       a.trigger_count,
       a.backfill,
       a.message,
       (k.acked_time IS NOT NULL) AS acknowledged,
       k.acked_by,
       k.acked_time
  FROM alarm a
  LEFT JOIN v_point_dict d
         ON d.terminal_id = a.terminal_id AND d.point_id = a.point_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT x.acked_by, x.acked_time
          FROM alarm_ack x
         WHERE x.alarm_id = a.alarm_id
         ORDER BY x.acked_time DESC
         LIMIT 1
  ) k ON TRUE
 WHERE a.status IN ('ACTIVE','RECOVERED')
   AND ($1 = '' OR a.terminal_id = $1)
 ORDER BY a.level DESC, a.occur_time DESC
 LIMIT 200

name: 格式化清单
func:
// 时间统一给毫秒，前端按本地时区渲染；unit / value 可能为空，
// 空值保持 null 不补 0——补 0 会被看成「实测到 0」。
msg.statusCode = 200;
msg.payload = (msg.payload || []).map(r => ({
    alarmId: Number(r.alarm_id),
    terminalId: r.terminal_id,
    pointId: r.point_id,
    pointName: r.point_name,
    workshop: r.workshop,
    alarmType: r.alarm_type,
    level: Number(r.level),
    status: r.status,
    triggerValue: r.trigger_value === null ? null : Number(r.trigger_value),
    unit: r.unit,
    thresholdValue: r.threshold_value === null ? null : Number(r.threshold_value),
    occurTime: new Date(r.occur_time).getTime(),
    lastTime: new Date(r.last_time).getTime(),
    triggerCount: Number(r.trigger_count),
    backfill: r.backfill === true,
    message: r.message,
    acknowledged: r.acknowledged === true,
    ackedBy: r.acked_by || null,
    ackedTime: r.acked_time ? new Date(r.acked_time).getTime() : null
}));
return msg;

name: 准备健康查询
func: msg.payload = null; return msg;

name: 健康查询
query:
SELECT now() AS db_time,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM alarm WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')   AS active_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM alarm WHERE status = 'RECOVERED') AS recovered_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM alarm_ack)                        AS ack_count
